landscapeBanner: Rotate your device for a better view of the cards
hint.play: this is the cheapest card that still takes the trick
hint.stay: you still hold something strong -- staying in is fine

tutorial.ranking: This ranking IS the game. The ten is the strongest card and J/Q/K/A are the four weakest -- the standard order turned inside out.
tutorial.follow: You must follow the led suit if you hold it. Cards you cannot legally play are not selectable.
tutorial.lastTrick: Everyone who does NOT take the final trick pays. Winning an early trick is worth nothing.
tutorial.toep: A toep raises the stake by one. Opponents stay in or fold, and folding costs the stake BEFORE the raise.
tutorial.controls: Ten lives lost and you are out. The last player standing wins.
